print_view_configuration.print_styles: @media print { .no-print { display: none !important; } .print-break-inside-avoid { break-inside: avoid; } body { background: white !important; font-size: 11pt; } .printable-container { width: 100% !important; margin: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; } }

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always set data-testid on interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, and status badges.
Do not use dark colors as heavy full-page gradients. Use subtle clean slate backgrounds with sharp 1px borders.
Ensure all schedule cells have high contrast text matching their specific shift colors.
Support both mobile-responsive view (cards/list view per day) and desktop matrix grid view.
Include local state persistence or mock API store so data created in Admin (new personil, leaves, custom logo) reflects instantly.
